Personally, I love learning the mythologies and folklore of different cultures; it's fascinating how much you can learn of a culture through them and how similar the stories are no matter where they come from. I’m so excited to meet and talk with you! See you soon!

teacher_info.intro: Hello! My name is Isis, and I'm from Texas in the United States. Instead, my accent is very neutral and easy to understand—similar to the clear pronunciation you hear on the news.
